integrity: Two included executable Python checkers and outputs support the proof; finite tests are corroborative and no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for finite products of chains of lengths at least two with the full transitive strict relation. Bound is not asserted optimal. Orbit-recovery statement does not imply identification among arbitrary posets; priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Colour refinement recovers every orbit of a finite product of chains
